name: Remnants of War
storyline:
In the aftermath of the Crimson Veil War, the land lies shrouded in quiet ruin. You traverse these war-torn lands as a lone wanderer. Upon reaching a village, you step into an old chapel standing precariously among the rebuilt facades. The town appears restored,yet remnants of war linger around you: rusted war machines, hidden traps, and desolate echoes of battlefield memories.

The silence breaks with a sudden cry. In that moment, you realize that the city is still under occupation.
summary: Remnants of War is a 2D action RPG with souls‑like elements. This is the demo version of my first game project. Choose your character, collect items, brew potions, and personalize your gameplay style as you dive into the adventure. Face challenging enemies and test your skills in a fast‑paced combat experience. The full version will feature more abilities, enemies, and new maps to explore.
